pause_interval.description: Pause interval in seconds between updates.

per_second_stats.description: Display values per second rather than totals (-d flag).

memory_totals.description: Display memory stats as totals even with per-second mode (-D flag).

force_per_second.description: Always show values per second even with pause interval > 1 (-S flag).

bytes_format.description: Display numbers of bytes rather than I/O requests (-b flag).

real_free_memory.description: Show extra line for 'real' free memory (-r flag).

human_readable.description: Display memory stats in human-readable numbers (-H flag).
